title: Incognito Mode Risk Calculator - Test Your Privacy Protection
metaDescription: Calculate your real privacy risk when using incognito mode. Discover what data you're still exposed to and get personalized protection tips.
description: Evaluate how well incognito mode protects your privacy based on your browsing habits and activities. Get a personalized risk score and learn what additional privacy measures you need to stay truly anonymous online.

formula: let baseRisk = 40; let browserMultipliers = {chrome: 1.0, firefox: 0.9, safari: 0.95, edge: 1.0, 'incognito-browser': 0.7}; let activityRisks = {shopping: 15, banking: 25, social: 20, research: 10, streaming: 12}; let networkRisks = {home: 5, work: 15, public: 30, mobile: 10}; let frequencyMultiplier = frequency * 0.1; let toolsReduction = additionalTools ? -15: 0; let sharedRisk = sharedDevice ? 20: 0; let totalRisk = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseRisk * browserMultipliers[browser] + activityRisks[activities] + networkRisks[networkType] + (frequencyMultiplier * 10) + toolsReduction + sharedRisk)); let grade = totalRisk <= 25 ? 'A': totalRisk <= 40 ? 'B': totalRisk <= 60 ? 'C': totalRisk <= 80 ? 'D': 'F'; let exposurePercent = Math.round(totalRisk * 0.8); return {riskScore: Math.round(totalRisk), protectionLevel: grade, exposurePercentage: exposurePercent};

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your privacy risk by analyzing your browser choice, online activities, network environment, and additional security measures. It accounts for the fact that incognito mode only prevents local data storage, not network-level tracking or ISP monitoring.
tips: Combine incognito mode with a VPN for better network-level privacy protection
Use a privacy-focused browser for enhanced private browsing with built-in privacy features
Avoid banking or sensitive activities on public WiFi, even in incognito mode
Remember that incognito mode doesn't hide your activity from your ISP or network administrator
Consider using privacy-focused browsers like a privacy-focused browser for stronger default protections

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy protection. You're using incognito mode effectively with additional security measures.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Decent protection but room for improvement. Consider adding a VPN or switching to a more private browser.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy gaps. Your data is still quite trackable despite using incognito mode.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Poor privacy protection. You need additional tools beyond incognito mode to protect your data.
